simple.summary: נָסַק (nâçaq) means to go up First listed occurrence: Ps 139 8.

definitions.full: H5266. nasaq נסק whence אֶסַּק Psa 139:8 according to Thes and others; but see סלק . סָלֵק verb ascend (loan-word from Aramaic סְלֵיק , ; Palmyrene סלק id. , Lzb 329 Cook 85 ; Late Hebrew סלק Pi`el remove ; Arabic ascend , Lane 1410 (also loan-word ?)); — only Qal Imperfect 1singular אֶסַּק Psa 139:8 if I ascend to heaven ( שָׁמַיִם ), thou art there (on form, = ֗֗֗ אֶסְלַק , see Ges § 66e Kö i. 301 Kau § 44 ).
